name: Home Assistant
description: Controls Home Assistant on your network by voice, and four favorites from a screen.

assistant_tools.name: control
assistant_tools.description: Turn a Home Assistant device on or off, or toggle it, by its name

assistant_tools.name: set_level
assistant_tools.description: Set a light's brightness, a cover's position or a fan's speed, in percent

assistant_tools.name: state
assistant_tools.description: Say the state of a Home Assistant device or sensor, such as a lock, a door or a temperature

assistant_tools.name: scene
assistant_tools.description: Run a Home Assistant scene or script by its name
